subject: general
question: Choose the sentence with no spelling error.

options.text: Your emergency contacts couldn't be reached.
Your emergency contatcs couldn't be reached.
Your emergancy contacts couldn't be reached.
Your emergency contacts coldn't be reaced.

solution:
The correct answer is "**Option 1.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence in option 1 "Your emergency contacts couldn't be reached" is free of error.
 
• **The word 'couldn't' is the correct contraction of 'could not.'**
 
• **'Emergency' is spelled correctly** which means a serious event that needs immediate action. (संकटकाल, आपातस्थिति)
 
 
• Example: This is a medical emergency needing urgent attention.
 
 
 
• **'Contacts' is also spelled correctly** which means a person you know who may be able to help or advise you or help you.
 
 
• Example: I have saved all my contacts on your phone.
 
 
 
• **Also, the sentence is grammatically correct.**

Hence, **the correct answer is option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​In option 2, 'Contatcs' is misspelled. The correct spelling is 'contacts.' (संपर्क)
 
• In option 3, 'Emergancy' is misspelled. The correct spelling is 'emergency.' (संकटकाल)
 
• In Option 4, 'Coldn't' is misspelled. The correct spelling is 'couldn't.
